punchline: Bill James sold his booklet to seventy-five people and kept writing.
thirty_sec: In 1977 Bill James self-published the 68-page Baseball Abstract, sold 75 copies through a small ad, then 250 the next year. In 2003 the Red Sox hired him as an adviser.
question: Which piece of work you have been doing quietly could you show to a few people this week?
key_contrast: Keep an idea hidden until it is perfect, or show it to a small audience now.
